voiceover: In Trinidad, rhythm does not wait for permission.
It hides in traffic, steelpan, school shoes, old jokes, and doubles before sunrise.
Kai Baptiste thought the day was chasing him.
He did not know the rhythm had already found him.
A stick has memory. A fighter has spirit. A drum has rhythm. A lavway has command.
And when the gayelle opens, every hidden debt comes due.
Now the rest of the islands will answer.
